howto.name: Upload your video
howto.text: Drag-and-drop MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, or M4V — up to 200 MB.

howto.name: Click Mute Video
howto.text: PrivaTools stream-copies the video and strips the audio track. The operation is lossless and takes about a second per minute of video.

faq.a: 100% — we stream-copy the video track without re-encoding. The output is bit-identical to the input minus the audio stream.
Yes, by the size of the audio track. For typical MP4s that's 5-15% smaller. The video portion is unchanged.

faq.q: Can I just mute the audio instead of removing it?
faq.a: This tool removes the audio track entirely. To replace with silence, use Video Converter and pick MP4 — that will re-encode and let you control audio.
